paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.01% on average, with Hang Seng strongest (+1.64%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-2.17%). Brent crude changed -2.48% to 112.03. Gold changed -0.56% to 4,009.0. Bitcoin changed -3.51% to 78,417.0391. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.989%, a relative move of -1.11%. Among the firms tracked, Apollo (+4.50%) and Deutsche Bank (+4.03%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Evonik set to reject BASF’s sweetened €11bn takeover bid (FT Companies). Speciality chemicals company may leave door open to future talks as larger rival seeks to create Germany-based industry champion Deals and capital markets: Investors double withdrawal requests at Partners’ flagship US private equity fund (FT Markets). Wealthy individuals sought to pull 15% of the fund’s net assets during the third quarter Central banks and macro: Bank of Japan says 2% inflation goal reached after decades of deflation (FT World). Japanese central bank holds interest rates as expectations mount for December increase Central banks and macro: Fed holds fire on interest rates despite intensifying inflation (FT World). Central bank to vote on monetary policy seven times next year in shift from decades-old custom of having eight such meetings Geopolitics and trade: European oil majors lift buybacks as Iran war drives bumper profits (FT Markets). Shell boss says he does not want surplus cash to ‘burn a hole in our pockets’
